decision.explanation: The original sources present three distinct individuals named Geoffrey Cook, each with their own birth dates. Document D1S1 refers to 'Geoff Cook' (born Geoffrey Cook), born on 9 October 1951. Document D2S13 refers to 'Geoffrey Cook', born on 12 March 1955. Documents D3S1 and D4S1 refer to 'Geoffrey William Cook', born on 9 February 1936. These are separate referents with the same name, so all three birth dates are valid and should be preserved.
